text: Aray ka Men holla heeferɓe Qurayshi ɓen, maandeeji Amen ɗin ka tatteeji leydi, tuma Allah yaññanta juulɓe ɓen, Men holla ɓe ɗi e maɓɓe tigiri, ka uddital Makka, haa ɓanngana ɓe ko sikke alaa e mu'un, wonnde ndee Alqur'aanaare, ko nde goonga, mo Allah seeditii wonnde ka ka Makko nde iwri. Ko hommbo non ɓuri mawnude Allah seedee? Si ko goonga ɓe muuynoo, ɓe yonndinorayno seedee Joomi maɓɓe on.
